title: I close a drive-in theater every night. Tonight the screen showed someone sitting in my truck.
story:
At midnight the drive-in screen lit up. I was the only one there, and the projector doesn't have a bulb.

I close the place every night. Sweep the lot, lock the snack bar, park my truck under the one working light in row six. The owner pulled the projector bulb in September. Said it was cheaper than fixing it.

But the screen was glowing. Gray, grainy footage of the lot. Row six. My truck. And someone sitting in my driver's seat, very still.

I looked at my real truck. Empty. I looked back at the screen. The figure had turned its head toward the camera.

So I ran for the projection booth, to unplug whatever was in there. The door was locked from the inside. Through the little window I could see the projector, dark and cold, its socket empty.

Then every speaker post on the lot crackled on at once. One calm, flat voice. "Back to your truck. The show's about you."

I turned around. The light over row six was off.

On the screen, my truck door hung open. The figure was walking toward the camera. Toward the booth. Toward me.

Its footsteps came from right behind me.
premise: drive-in closer sees the bulbless projector show footage of someone in his truck; speaker posts tell him the show is about him; the footage is shot from where he stands and the figure walks up behind him
theme: night shift at a drive-in theater
